test_title: SSC CHSL Tier-1 2022: Official Paper (Held On: 20 March, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which among the following constitutional amendments of the Indian Constitution deals with the formation of Sikkim as a state?
solution:
Correct Answer **36th**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**The Constitution (36th Amendment) Act, 1975: 

 
• The act provides that the Legislative assembly of Sikkim shall not consist of more than 32 members.
 
• The Assembly of Sikkim unanimously adopted a resolution on 10th April 1974 with 32 members.
 
• It is then proposed to include Sikkim as a** full-fledged state in the First Schedule to the Constitution.**
 
• And allot to Sikkim one seat in the council
